literal: Affection, knowledge, examined word-skill: to those who deliver a message, without (these) not forming, (are these) three.
translation: Affection, knowledge, and well-considered eloquence are the three indispensable qualities for those who deliver an embassy's message.
modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, ஆராய்ந்து பேசும் சொல்வன்மை ஆகிய மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவர்களுக்கு இன்றியமையாத பண்புகளாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the three essential qualities required of an envoy. First is affection or loyalty towards their own king, ensuring they act in the state's best interest. Second is knowledge, which allows them to understand complex political situations. Third is well-considered eloquence, the ability to choose the right words after careful thought. Together, these three are described as indispensable for anyone entrusted with delivering a diplomatic message.
